face.text: Deathrattle: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, return this to your hand.
face.flavorText: Apparently it really was just a flesh wound.

face.name: Justicar Trueheart
face.text: Battlecry: Replace your starting Hero Power with a better one.
face.flavorText: It's like putting racing stripes and a giant spoiler on your hero power.

face.name: 塔维什·雷矛
face.text: 在一只友方野兽攻击后，从你的牌库中召唤一只法力值消耗减少（1）点的野兽。
face.flavorText: “快，宝贝儿！敌人数量太多了！到处都是蛇！它们看起来是有点萌，但那毕竟是凶猛的蛇！”——塔维什·雷矛

face.name: Tavish Stormpike
face.text: After a friendly Beast attacks, summon a Beast from your deck that costs (1) less.
face.flavorText: "Hurry up, laddie, we're getting overrun! Serpents everywhere! They may look cute, but do ye see the fury in their eyes?!" —Tavish Stormpike

face.name: 暗影珠宝师汉纳尔
face.text: 在你使用一张奥秘牌后，发现一张不同职业的奥秘牌。
face.flavorText: 小朋友，你是否有很多问号？

face.name: Shadowjeweler Hanar
face.text: After you play a Secret, Discover a Secret from a different class.
face.flavorText: What is a shadowjeweler? A miserable little pile of secrets.

face.name: 迈拉·腐泉
face.text: 战吼： 发现一张亡语随从牌，并获得其亡语。

face.name: Myra Rotspring
face.text: Battlecry: Discover a Deathrattle minion. Also gain its Deathrattle.
face.flavorText: On her first day on the job, Myra removed the smoke detectors.

face.text: 嘲讽，亡语：随机使一个友方随从获得“亡语：召唤格雷布。”
face.flavorText: 种一棵树的最佳时间是二十年前，其次是你的随从倒下的时候。

face.name: Greybough
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion "Deathrattle: Summon Greybough."
face.flavorText: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The next best time is when you lose a minion.

face.text: 战吼：召唤两个0/3的龙卵。下个回合它们将孵化为4/4并具有突袭的幼龙。
